# Exact pins for .github/workflows/audio-transcribe.yml (faster-whisper "small" on CPU, Python 3.11).
# numpy is pinned at 2.4.6: 2.5.5 requires Python >=3.12 and ships no cp311 wheels, so the first live
# run (45102743738, 2026-11-22) failed at install on the workflow's Python 3.11. 2.4.6 is the newest
# numpy with cp311 wheels. The original local verification ran on Python 3.12, which masked this.
# Verified by actually transcribing with this set locally on 2026-11-22 (FLAC and MP4/AAC clips, Python 3.12).
# av is pinned at 16.1.0 on purpose: a fresh resolve installed av 19.0.2, whose av.open() dropped the
# metadata_errors keyword that faster-whisper 1.2.1 passes — every transcription died on decode.
# 16.1.0 is the newest av release verified to decode with faster-whisper 1.2.1.
av==16.1.0
ctranslate2==4.9.1
faster-whisper==1.2.1
huggingface_hub==2.4.0
numpy==2.4.6
onnxruntime==1.32.0
PyYAML==6.0.4
tokenizers==0.23.3
tqdm==4.70.1
